topics.title: Definition and Function of Oriki
topics.summary: El Conquistador frames oriki as a praise poem that serves as flattery to incentivize the Orisha.
topics.detailedNotes: Oriki is described as a structured poem of praise that functions like flattery, encouraging the Orisha to respond positively. It is recited in various ritual contexts to honor the deity. The teaching emphasizes that oriki is not merely decorative language but a functional component of the ceremony. The poetical form often includes a lead and chorus in Nigerian practice, but the core purpose remains consistent across traditions.
topics.practiceImplications: Practitioners should recite oriki whenever casting Obi or during head rogations to honor the Orisha and invite their presence.
